title: Fairway to Heaven on 30A's Dune Allen Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: This stately vacation home on Scenic 30A overlooks a beautiful fairway and lush green at the highly acclaimed Santa Rosa Golf and Beach Club. It is only a very short stroll away from the white sugary shoreline. There are comfortable accommodations for fourteen beach-going guests
description_expanded: This stately vacation home on Scenic 30A overlooks a beautiful fairway and lush green at the highly acclaimed Santa Rosa Golf and Beach Club . It is only a very short stroll away from the white sugary shoreline. There are comfortable accommodations for fourteen beach-going guests with five bedrooms and multiple beds. This gracious rental home's amenities and creature comforts will make everyone feel like they have arrived in paradise. Amenities include a heated private pool, golf cart, bicycles, and an in-home movie theater - just to name a few. If you love the beach and dream of golf, staying here will be like heaven! Fairway to Heaven has a bright, spacious open living area with a two-story-tall cathedral ceiling. Walls of windows with paneled sliding glass doors lead out to the green tropical poolside scenery and relaxing sun deck. A row of tropical palm trees reminds you that you are at the beach, while a unique private corner angled swimming pool overlooks the golf course. Inside, two dove gray couches and a couple of fashionable vintage-modern bucket chairs face a floor-to-ceiling white stone fireplace. An extra-large flatscreen TV is mounted above a thick rustic wood mantle for watching the big game or your favorite show. A lavish built-in bar with gleaming white quartz countertops includes multiple stools to enjoy favorite drinks. The stunning state-of-the-art kitchen also has a quartz-topped island with additional seating, rich dark chocolate-colored custom cabinetry, and brushed stainless steel appliances ready to create any culinary delight. The adjacent formal dining area has a rectangular, beach-washed hardwood table with eight high-backed light gray chairs beneath a unique glowing glass orb chandelier. A half-bath powder room is also off the living area for added convenience. The expansive lower-level master bedroom includes a king-sized bed with a palatial cloth headboard facing a vast stone fireplace mantle. A large wall-mounted flatscreen TV sits above a dresser for evening entertainment. Sliding glass doors provide views and access to the refreshing swimming pool. A luxurious ensuite master bath has a deep soaking tub, a curved glass-walled walk-in shower, and two raised vanity sinks on a long marble counter.   A majestic open staircase sweeps up to the guest quarters from the entry foyer with dramatic views into the living area. One guest bedroom with a soaring vaulted ceiling has a king-sized bed against a royal blue wall and French doors leading to a spacious balcony with golf course views. An ensuite bath is lavished with bright tropical fish and includes double vanities and a walk-in shower. The other guest bedroom has a king-sized bed adorned with a magnificent creamy cloth tufted headboard against a chic multi-striped wall. A tall vaulted ceiling provides a feeling of openness, while double glass doors lead to the partially covered wraparound balcony. An ensuite bathroom includes two raised copper bowl vanity sinks, white quartz countertops, and a tub shower combination with a striking tile backsplash. The other guest quarters are loft-like and perfect for the kids, with built-in twin beds crowned at the far end with bunks that include four more twin beds. It is accessed through a theater room with a giant screen, a cozy couch, a bar with raised seating, and two massive bean bag chairs for lounging. This room also features a kitchenette with a full-size refrigerator for keeping your favorite drinks cool and a microwave for buttery "movie-theater" popcorn! This fantastic Dune Allen Beach location is near popular restaurants, friendly bars with live music, shopping adventures, outdoor amphitheater concerts, and fun seasonal festivities at Gulf Place . The championship eighteen-hole Santa Rosa Golf Course is just out your backdoor, a par 72 course spanning over eighty-five acres of rolling fairways. It includes forested borders, pristine wetlands, and lovely lagoons. This gorgeous golf course just received a multi-million dollar landscape renovation to highlight the sensational scenery. The award-winning Vue on 30A restaurant is right across the street that sits high upon a sugary dune overlooking the jeweled waters of the glittering gulf. It features gourmet Caribbean-styled seafood entrees, tasty appetizers, and wine and craft cocktails. The elegant dining room also features spectacular views of the sparkling seascape below. It is a popular destination for birthday parties, hallmark anniversaries, rehearsal dinners, and wedding receptions. First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access and Built-In Bar, Kitchen, Dining, King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Patio Access, Powder Room,  Laundry,  Garage Access. Second Floor: King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo and Balcony Access, Bedroom with Two Twin Bunks and Two Twin Beds, Bedroom with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Balcony Access, Theatre Room with Kitchenette, Powder Room, Rollaway Crib (sheets not provided). *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
